general.name: IAP Desktop [Win]
general.description: Stages Google IAP Desktop so each user installs it at next logon via Active Setup (per-user MSI). https://github.com/TechCollective/DattoRMM_Components

variables.name: msiUrl
variables.description: https:// URL of IapDesktop.msi. Leave blank for Google's latest GitHub release. Set to a specific release URL to pin a version.

variables.name: reinstallExisting
variables.description: true = force every user on the device to re-run the install at their next logon, even if the staged version has not changed.
